records.title: Web: application and history editing
records.scope: Edit company, role, location, notes and URL. Maintain current status and ownership after history edits or deletions.
records.tests:
122 automated tests passed.
Six browser acceptance groups and the local production build passed.
records.boundary: Editing, refresh persistence, board/timeline consistency and user isolation verified.
records.decision: Selectively integrate editing capabilities from testing. Let the server maintain current status and validate ownership.

records.title: Web: calendar and tasks
records.scope: Unify scheduled interviews and assessment deadlines. Show upcoming, overdue and missing-time events. Refresh after edits or deletions.
records.tests:
139 automated tests passed.
Browser schedule acceptance and the local production build passed.
records.boundary: Other windows update through refresh or polling. No real-time push.
records.decision: Keep interview times and assessment deadlines independent. Missing times remain explicit instead of reusing status dates.

records.title: Web: in-app reminders
records.scope: Support 15/30-minute and 1/24-hour lead times, read state, 10-minute snooze, cancellation and rescheduling.
records.tests:
161 automated tests passed.
Browser reminder acceptance and the local production build passed.
records.boundary: In-app reminders only. Closing the app does not send email or system push notifications.
records.decision: Build reminders on unified schedules. Rescheduling and deletion invalidate old reminders. Preserve read, snooze and cancellation state.

records.title: Web: statistics and analytics
records.scope: Separate current status distribution from application-cohort stage conversion. Correct date/timezone boundaries and integrate analytics.
records.tests:
183 automated tests passed.
Browser analytics acceptance and the local production build passed.
records.boundary: Original timezones cannot be recovered for historical date-only values. Interpret the stored times.
records.decision: Display current status and cohort conversion separately, using complete local dates and an explicit timezone.

records.title: Web: sync controls and authentication
records.scope: Add immediate sync, failed-item retry, queue/results display, password recovery and fixed 12-hour/30-day sessions.
records.tests: Sync, recovery tokens, rate limits, sessions and browser flows verified. Production build passed.
records.boundary: Real password-recovery email delivery remains unverified. Requires a Resend key and verified sender domain.
records.decision: Expose sync/retry outcomes and backlog. Define Remember me through an absolute session duration and validate recovery tokens separately.

records.title: Web: upload security
records.scope: Allow PDF/DOCX/PNG/JPEG up to 4 MiB, validate content and require private attachment downloads with ownership checks.
records.tests:
222 automated tests passed.
Browser upload/download acceptance and the local production build passed.
records.boundary: Legacy large files remain subject to platform response limits. Object-storage migration is not implemented.
records.decision: Use a type allowlist, content validation and private downloads. Never execute uploaded content based on its declared MIME type.

records.title: Web: account and mailbox security
records.scope: Add single-use OAuth state, session binding, PKCE, dedicated login/registration rate limits and error feedback.
records.tests:
248 automated tests passed.
Chrome security/regression acceptance and the production build passed.
records.boundary: Real Gmail/Outlook consent remains unverified. Mock callbacks and security boundaries were tested.
records.decision: Bind mailbox authorization to single-use state, the login session and PKCE. Apply dedicated authentication rate limits.

records.title: iOS: foundation and applications
records.scope: Add four SwiftUI tabs, login, Keychain sessions, application viewing/creation/editing, schedules and mailbox overview.
records.tests: 14 distinct tests passed at the time. Real local-backend persistence, Debug and unsigned Release builds passed.
records.boundary: Remaining at this milestone: native history/schedule editing, mail authorization/sync, push, statistics, files and release preparation.
records.decision: Reuse the existing backend and database in a SwiftUI iPhone client. Store credentials in Keychain and isolate demo data from real accounts.

records.title: iOS: Chinese and English switching
records.scope: Support Follow system, Simplified Chinese and English with immediate persisted switching, including dates, errors and navigation titles.
records.tests: 19 distinct iOS tests passed cumulatively. Simulator UI, real local-backend and Debug/Release builds passed.
records.boundary: Physical devices, developer signing and TestFlight remain unverified. User content retains its original language.
records.decision: Persist the language choice and update dates, errors and navigation consistently. The bilingual iOS product remains supported.

records.title: iOS: application status and history
records.scope: Add, edit and delete native history. Use server-calculated status, preserve mail provenance and protect against stale responses. Support both UI languages.
records.tests:
31 distinct iOS tests passed across runs.
25 server regressions, bidirectional web/app acceptance and Debug/Release builds passed.
records.boundary: Schedule times were read-only at this milestone. Native time editing was next. Device, signing and TestFlight acceptance remained outstanding.
records.decision: Reuse web history APIs and server status calculation. Prevent stale native responses from replacing confirmed edits and preserve email provenance.

records.title: iOS: schedule editing and navigation
records.scope: Set, change and clear interview times and assessment deadlines. Open application details from schedules. Independent time edits preserve status and support both UI languages.
records.tests:
37 distinct iOS tests passed across runs.
64 server regressions, bidirectional web/app acceptance and Debug/Release builds passed.
records.boundary: Native mailbox authorization/sync and push remained next. Device, signing and TestFlight acceptance remained outstanding.
records.decision: Edit schedule fields independently so changing a time cannot accidentally change application status.

records.title: iOS: mail controls and authorization
records.scope: Add immediate sync, failed-item retry, results and manual review. Implement Gmail/Outlook system authorization and a secure native callback.
records.tests:
51 distinct iOS tests passed across runs.
258 server tests, isolated API acceptance and Web/Debug/Release builds passed.
records.boundary: Real Gmail/Outlook consent and mail retrieval remain unverified. Device, signing and TestFlight acceptance remain outstanding.
records.decision: Reuse sync and review logic. Use system authorization and a dedicated secure native callback. Record real-provider consent as pending.

records.title: iOS: in-app reminders
records.scope: Add reminder lists, unread/read state, snooze, cancellation and settings. Rescheduling/clearing/deletion invalidate old reminders. Clear data at logout.
records.tests:
66 distinct iOS tests passed across runs.
258 server tests, isolated API acceptance and Debug/Release builds passed.
records.boundary: APNs background push is not implemented. Developer configuration, device binding and push deduplication are required. Device, signing and TestFlight remain unverified.
records.decision: First reuse shared reminder state and actions with foreground refresh. Keep background push explicitly outstanding.

records.title: iOS: statistics and attachments
records.scope: Add current status distribution, stage conversion and date filtering. Upload, natively preview and export attachments using the same data as the web.
records.tests:
74 distinct iOS tests passed across runs.
42 statistics/attachment server regressions, isolated acceptance and Debug/Release builds passed.
records.boundary: Physical devices and third-party file providers remain unverified. This milestone used an account-level file library with a 4 MB per-file limit.
records.decision: Use explicit ranges and the phone timezone for statistics. Reuse the account file library and handle native preview and export separately.

records.title: Mail: durable storage and retry
records.scope: Store mail before advancing cursors. Distinguish pending, succeeded and failed items. Support retry and deduplicate applications/history.
records.tests: Reliable-sync code was committed. See the commit and contemporaneous notes. No historical test count has been invented.
records.boundary: Check transaction support and indexes before deploying against real mailboxes and the existing database.
records.decision: Confirm durable storage with majority write acknowledgment before moving the cursor. Commit business effects and success marking together. Failed items remain retryable.

records.title: Mail: pagination and shared sync
records.scope: Complete Gmail/Outlook pagination and sync-count bounds. Share manual/scheduled sync logic and return processing counts.
records.tests: Pagination and shared sync code was committed. This retrospective entry is based on the commit and its notes.
records.boundary: Continue observing real-provider pagination and production mailboxes.
records.decision: Persist pagination continuation for both providers, share manual/scheduled processing and counters, and validate count bounds.

records.title: Web: Vercel deployment fix
records.scope: Upgrade Next.js to a secure version to resolve the deployment blocker at the time.
records.tests: The commit documents the version change. A later Vercel deployment on 2026-10-30 was confirmed successful.
records.boundary: This entry records the historical fix milestone. It does not establish deployment of newly added code.
records.decision: Upgrade Next.js in response to the deployment blocker. Retain checks for failed commits and the subsequent fix.

records.title: Mail: AI extraction and matching
records.scope: Separate classification/extraction, validate output, improve matching and protect newer status from old mail. Implement Semi/Strict review policies.
records.tests: Fixed mail fixtures cover application confirmations, assessments, interviews, rejections, offers, marketing and incomplete information.
records.boundary: Continue evaluating real-mail extraction. Incomplete information still requires manual review.
records.decision: Semi automatically updates only clearly matched existing applications. New applications, offers, rejections and uncertainty require review. Strict requires review for every item.

records.title: Design: English iPhone prototype archive
records.scope: Archive the English Figma prototype link, version notes and design acceptance.
records.tests: 27 screens/result states and 85 navigation actions checked.
records.boundary: Prototype interactions are simulated. Automatic immutable Figma snapshot export is not configured.
records.decision: Use an English prototype, Inter and vector icons. Distinguish simulated interaction, design checks and real business acceptance.

records.title: Web and iOS: bulk actions
records.scope: Bulk archive/restore, change status and accept/ignore mail. Return per-item results, retain failed selections and deduplicate retries.
records.tests: 266 backend tests passed. iOS: 73 passed, one skipped. Browser, simulator UI and builds passed.
records.boundary: Web deployment succeeded on 2026-10-30. iOS was not distributed through TestFlight.
records.decision: Make archiving reversible and preserve history. Use independent per-item transactions, retain failed selections and never guess bulk mail targets.

records.title: iOS: Safari job sharing
records.scope: Save offline job drafts through the Safari extension. Complete company/role and explicitly confirm the account in the main app before creation.
records.tests: iOS: 78 passed, one skipped. Real Safari sharing, relaunch, isolated-database checks and Release compilation passed.
records.boundary: Device/TestFlight distribution still requires developer signing and App Group configuration. The feature was committed locally at this milestone.
records.decision: Keep credentials out of offline drafts. Use an App Group and confirm the account in the main app. Do not force-launch the main app.

records.title: Web and iOS: versioned application documents
records.scope: Link resumes, cover letters and portfolios to applications. Retain independent versions and byte snapshots, with detail preview and download.
records.tests: 272 backend tests passed. iOS: 80 passed, two skipped. Real API, browser and iPhone UI acceptance passed.
records.boundary: Snapshots survive source-file deletion and are cleaned up with the application. The feature was committed locally; production APIs awaited deployment at this milestone.
records.decision: Number each document kind independently and retain immutable byte snapshots. Source deletion preserves downloads; application deletion cleans snapshots transactionally.
